# Baseten — Baseten AI Startup Program

Two separate credit pools: up to $25,000 for Dedicated Inference or Training and up to $2,500 for Model APIs, plus priority support and GTM consulting.

### Tiers

Each tier has its own eligibility. A headline figure is usually the top tier, not
what a typical applicant receives.

| Tier | Amount | The vendor's wording | Gate |
|---|---|---|---|
| Dedicated Inference or Training | $25,000 | Up to $25,000 in credits for Dedicated Inference or Training | No partner needed |
| Model APIs | $2,500 | Up to $2,500 in credits for Model APIs | No partner needed |

### Not covered

- Companies that have previously received Baseten credits

### Notes

Page states "your funding stage should be Seed to Series A and you started less than 5 years ago" and "artificial intelligence needs to be core to your primary products or solutions". Net-new restriction: "Only net new customers can be enrolled into the AI startup program. It means that you have never received any credits from Baseten before". No program duration, geography, or employee cap published. Independently re-audited: a second reviewer opened the vendor page and checked the quote, amount and source.
